# What no target lowers yet is refused where it is written rather than emitted
# as a bracket that never reports: @update under a `for` (one flag cannot say
# which copy's key was written), and @update or a list's change events on
# android, which brackets a lifetime natively. The interpreter runs them.

! sngl generate --platform fyne --lang go -o out loop.sngl
stderr 'loop.sngl:8:29: an effect''s @update under a `for` is not implemented on a compiled target yet'

! sngl generate --platform android --lang kotlin -o out update.sngl
stderr 'update.sngl:6:22: an effect''s @update is not implemented on a target that brackets a lifetime natively yet'

! sngl generate --platform android --lang kotlin -o out changes.sngl
stderr 'changes.sngl:7:22: an effect''s @insert is not implemented on a target that brackets a lifetime natively yet'

sngl test changes.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- changes.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

component saver ui.node {
    var xs list<int> = []
    var log list<string> = []
    effect(on = xs, @insert(at, x) { log.push("insert {at}") },
        @update {})

    func add() {
        xs.push(1)
    }

    ui.text #out(value = log.join(","))
}

func testInsert(t test.Test, c saver) {
    c.add()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "insert 0")
}

ui.window(title = "Saver") {
    saver
}
-- loop.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component rows ui.node {
    var xs list<list<int>> = [[1], [2]]
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        for var x = xs {
            effect(on = x, @update { n += 1 })
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title = "Rows") {
    rows
}
-- update.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component saver ui.node {
    var xs list<int> = []
    var n = 0
    effect(on = xs, @update { n += 1 })
    ui.text(value = "{n}")
}

ui.window(title = "Saver") {
    saver
}
